AI Agent Harness: Questions & Answers

A practical guide to business-specific execution systems, evaluation and controlled improvement.

What is an AI agent harness?

An AI agent harness is the execution system around a model. It organizes task context, authorized tools, execution steps, quality checks and human approval. The model generates or reasons; the harness determines how those capabilities are used for a business task.

Does a self-improving harness change production on its own?

Here, self-improvement means controlled iteration: record failures and human corrections, propose a candidate, compare it with a baseline on independent samples, and apply agreed release gates. It does not mean unrestricted production changes or necessarily training model weights.

How does a harness differ from prompts and RAG?

Prompts specify a model’s task and output requirements. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) retrieves relevant material. A harness can connect both with tools, permissions, workflow state, validation and human review. The task determines which components are needed.

How does a data and knowledge factory use a harness?

It connects document extraction, source evidence, field validation and human review in a workflow. Errors and corrections inform the next candidate, which is checked with independent evaluation. The procurement example on this website is synthetic, not a customer outcome.

How do you know an iteration is better?

Agree the task and acceptance criteria first. Compare a candidate with a baseline on independent samples, while checking regressions, cost and cases requiring human review. A demonstration or the samples used for optimization alone cannot establish a quality improvement.

How can we start, and should we send business data?

Email contact@harnessloop.ai with your task, current difficulties and acceptance criteria. The website’s brief tool generates text locally in your browser. Do not send medical records, sensitive personal information, credentials or client secrets in an initial enquiry. Data access and delivery scope are agreed separately.
